mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a pleasant 66 degrees with mainly clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park and a waxing crescent moon visible in the sky.

The Verona Senior Center is actively seeking volunteers to support their community programs. They are asking for a commitment of at least two times per month, and while some roles require light physical activity, it is a great way to respect the dignity and worth of others in our city. You can apply online or visit their front desk for a form.

There is so much happening in and around Verona! Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, don't miss the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds or the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Looking ahead, keep an eye out for UGM at Epic Systems and yoga classes at Insight Wellness on August 17, followed by trivia nights on August 18.
In our weekly police report, on Wednesday, August 6, officers stopped a driver for erratic behavior, which unfortunately resulted in an arrest for a fourth O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the classic and tasty Turtle. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM tomorrow morning.
